cards.name: Ghostrick Cutifer

effects.lua_implementation: aux.AddXyzProcedure requires Level 4 materials, minimum two and maximum 99, and enables revive limit.

official_references.matched_structure: 2+/3+ standard Xyz procedure using a maximum-count helper.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon this card using a Rank 3 or lower Ghostrick Xyz Monster you control (transfer its materials).
effects.lua_implementation: The alternate procedure filters a face-up Rank 3-or-lower Ghostrick Xyz, transfers materials through the helper, and records an End-Phase oath flag to permit only one alternate summon per turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Once-per-turn alternate Xyz Summon using one controlled Xyz/archetype monster and transferring materials.
Transfers material groups in a successive Xyz operation.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn: Detach 1 material, target 1 Set card your opponent controls; Set that card to your field; if it was a monster, it can be Flip Summoned this turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A soft-once-per-turn ignition detaches one material, targets a face-down opponent card with a corresponding free zone, moves it face-down to the controller's Monster or Spell & Trap Zone, and clears STATUS_SET_TURN for monsters.

official_references.matched_structure: Moves an opponent-controlled card to the effect controller.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn: Target 1 other Ghostrick monster you control; attach this card to it as material. Transfer this card's materials to that monster.
effects.lua_implementation: The implementation restricts the other controlled Ghostrick target to a face-up Xyz Monster, transfers this card's materials, then overlays this card onto it.

official_references.matched_structure: Targets two Winged Beast Xyz Monsters, attaches one to the other, and transfers its materials.

effects.issue: Only Xyz Monsters can legally hold Xyz Materials, while the printed target is any other Ghostrick monster. The current Xyz-only restriction is executable but narrower than the text. Exact resolution requires changing the target to 'Ghostrick Xyz Monster' or adding unsupported engine/card-rule semantics that allow non-Xyz monsters to hold materials.

coverage_override.reason: Complete card override retained after re-reading every printed clause, current Lua registration/procedure, relevant engine helpers/constants, and each cited official Omega script/database record.

cards.audit_note: Adversarial completion review: effect 4 retained. Prior labels were not treated as evidence.
